instruction: Who is the most followed artist I follow on Spotify?
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed, so the goal only demands knowledge predicates plus (task-completed). The single artist object stands for the runtime-selected answer (the followed artist with the highest follower_count); show_following_artists discovers the followed artist ids, show_artist retrieves follower counts, and complete_task passes the artist's name as the answer. The max-selection itself is done at runtime by the executor, not by the planner. Pagination of show_following_artists is abstracted into one action.
